| `spec.settings.cache.maxEntries` | `integer` | How many answers the cache holds, e.g. 200000; when it is full the least recently used answer is dropped. More entries mean more cache hits and more memory; 0 turns the cache off.<br>Format: `int64`<br>Range: at least 0 |

| `spec.settings.cache.prefetch.window` | `string` | Time over which the hits for cache.prefetch.threshold are counted, e.g. 2h.<br>Length: at most 8192 |

| `spec.settings.cache.serveStale.ttl` | `string` | When every upstream server fails, keep answering from expired cache entries for up to this long after they expired, e.g. 72h, so names you already use keep working through an outage. 0 turns it off (RFC 8767 serve-stale).<br>Length: at most 8192 |

| `spec.settings.ratelimit.ipv6` | `map[string]integer` | Queries per minute allowed per IPv6 address or network, by prefix length: 128 is one address (default 600), 64 a /64 network (6000), 56 a /56 (12000). | `spec.settings.ratelimit.maxBuckets` | `integer` | Most addresses and networks tracked at once, e.g. 65536 (0 means 65536); the least recently seen is forgotten first and starts again with a full allowance.<br>Format: `int64`<br>Range: at least 0 |

| `spec.settings.response.dns64.prefix` | `string` | Synthesize IPv6 answers from IPv4 for a NAT64 network. Empty disables DNS64. ## Status

KudurruStatus records runtime state and observed cluster configuration.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.blocking` | `object` | BlockingStatus is replicated absolute-time state, never a node-local timer.<br>Validation: disabledUntil requires disabled (`!has(self.disabledUntil) \|\| self.disabled`) |
| `status.blocking.disabled` | `boolean` | **Required.** |
| `status.blocking.disabledUntil` | `string` | DisabledUntil is absent for an indefinite disable. Expiry enables blocking without waiting for another write or renewing on restart.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_kudurru.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: Kudurru
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  settings:
    cache:
      maxEntries: 100000
    blocking:
      defaultResponse: nxdomain
    response:
      filterAAAA: false
```
